assessment.guidance: Judge the final work yourself. Packaging checks are not quality scores.

prompt: make a static webapp showing a 3d interactive snow globe showing a scene with a snow-capped peak

settings.thinkingBudgetBasis: CLI/model default; no explicit token budget

artifact.note: Reviewed the static HTML/CSS/JS, removed stray patch markers, confirmed the file is self-contained and valid, and checked packaging successfully. The globe includes animated snowfall, drag rotation, scroll tilt, shake, pause/resume, rotation controls, reset, responsive layout, and an illustrated snow-capped peak scene.

cost.formula: (uncachedInput * inputRate + cacheRead * cachedInputRate + cacheWrite * cacheWriteRate + output * outputRate) / 1000000
assumptions: Reasoning tokens are included in output, not billed twice
